title: A personal Spotlight can show a 0% Tip jar when the Member can receive tips (Spotlight split, SPL-06)

source.ref: Owner picks 2026-10-28: free value first, the Tip block on the free personal Spotlight

detail: Adds the member-only tip block (label Tip jar). The public Spotlight is ISR and cookie-free, so the block is a server-rendered card with a Send a tip link to /people/<handle>#tip, where the existing composer and sign-in round trip live. The Spotlight reader gains a boolean canTip (payouts live and the Member's account ready, the same rule as the in-app canTipRecipient), fail-closed to false and never carrying a Stripe id; the block collapses when it is false. Tips stay 0% on every tier. The in-app profile keeps its own Tip button.

verify.note: Fails on main (no tip block); passes here.
